scope: New course evidence reader and public synthetic evaluator; development observations, not a production incident report

families.pin_limit: Intermediate pre-lock development source was not separately committed; exact final regression/source are pinned.
families.root_cause: Separate history check and append allowed two cooperating curators to publish different versions.
families.detection_rule: Course source manifest history must contain exactly one version and exact replay must return it.
families.preventive_control: Bounded nonblocking flock on existing canonical registry DB descriptor across freeze/check/append/readback; no extra store or lockfile.
families.limits: Cooperative service callers only; direct canonical writers bypassing the protocol remain outside this guarantee.
families.rollback: Revert source feature; preserve canonical evidence and existing LMS schema.

families.root_cause: Excerpt truncation could hide another curator-declared conflict member.
families.detection_rule: A matched declared group must retain in-scope member references independent of excerpt selection; lesson omissions are visible.
families.preventive_control: Pre-budget matched record IDs, required metadata floor, explicit omission counts/reasons.
families.limits: Only explicitly annotated conflicts; no automatic semantic discovery.

families.root_cause: Checking citation bytes alone omitted host-owned expected course binding and source manifest.
families.detection_rule: Copied valid citations in wrong/missing scope receive no credit.
families.preventive_control: Required expected binding and manifest ref derived before reader execution from host-owned inputs; recorded in protocol.

families.observation: Before repair, grader accepted course_version=True and source_ref.version=True as integer1 through Python dictionary equality.
families.root_cause: Python equality aliases Boolean/integer and some floating-point values; raw nested metadata was not parsed.
families.regression: Boolean and floating-point version alias regressions in reader/evaluator tests
families.detection_rule: JSON identities must preserve value types and ArtifactRefs require strict positive integers.
families.preventive_control: Typed nested ArtifactRef parsing plus canonical JSON identity comparison; fixed source fixture unchanged.
families.sibling_sweep: Reviewed optional pinned-record metadata and source manifest binding; default context tests also pass.
